names: João Pessoa na Palma da Mão, the municipal app of João Pessoa, Brazil (T1-6–T1-9; cards B3–B5)
homonyms.basis: A collision at the name (Capture Registry, per_dim.reached 'collision'; CAP-1-09): the composition gives two senses of 'Pessoa Digital', the edition first and the municipal digital services of João Pessoa, Brazil, second (T1-1), the second from three of the five cards, Instagram videos known here by their titles alone (F26–F28; CAP-1-03). The app is a distinct entity, never a sense of the edition's name; the census keeps the edition apart from the Arquivo Pessoa (LS-28), and English Wikipedia lists Project Estranhar Pessoa as a link of its own (F36).
distinct_entities: João Pessoa na Palma da Mão, the app of the municipality of João Pessoa (B3–B5; T1-6–T1-9), and the city of João Pessoa, Brazil
Estranhar Pessoa, the edition's framework project, 'running since mid-2013' at estranharpessoa.com (F12, F36), made the CCeH's in T (T1-4; CAP-1-02)

the Arquivo Pessoa (arquivopessoa.net), the census's separate row and the edition's neighbour, which holds the published work under its names (LS-28, LS-29); its /non row datasets/negative-of-the-negative/v2/rows/arquivo-pessoa.json
the Cologne Center for eHumanities (CCeH), a participant in 2014–2016 and the author of card 1 (F2, F4, F5)
the DCH, the edition's host (F12); the challenge page's footer names the Data Center for the Humanities among Cologne's units (F30), and the saved sources do not expand the abbreviation
the Laboratório de Estudos Literários Avançados (ELAB) and the Institute of Literature and Tradition (IELT), the Lisbon partner as the two cards name it (F5, F17)
EAFIT University, Medellín (F8, F20); the Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (F7); NFDI Text+ (F21)
the Biblioteca Nacional de Portugal's Espólio de Fernando Pessoa (N3), 'the physical archive' in #668 (D668-02), T's 'National Library of Portugal collection' (T1-4), on no card
Jorge Uribe's printed editions of Reis with Jerónimo Pizarro (Tinta-da-China 2016; Pre-Textos 2025), recorded in #1675: a person's other work, outside the entity

captures.description: THE EDITION'S NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The term Pessoa Digital most commonly refers to digital academic and archival projects dedicated to the Portuguese poet Fernando Pessoa, or to municipal digital services in Brazil.' Section 1, the Digital Edition of Fernando Pessoa (pessoadigital.pt): 'A digital scholarly edition and research framework'; it 'connects with ... the Estranhar Pessoa project hosted by the Cologne Center for eHumanities (CCeH) and the National Library of Portugal collection'. Section 2, João Pessoa na Palma da Mão, the municipality's app of 'over 200 municipal services'. Cards: the CCeH's project page, the University of Rostock's page on the edition, three Instagram videos on the app.

atoms.evidence: A digital scholarly edition and research framework dedicated to the works and manuscripts of the renowned Portuguese writer Fernando Pessoa (1888–1935).
The digital edition is hosted by the DCH.
